svg.text: → continues a session that already exists, named by its letter⇢ starts a new one
jig open · merge only on the owner's word
a review with blocking findings · three rounds at most; a fourth is refused and Bug runs
a sync with a hand-resolved conflict · a clean sync needs nothing
a fourth fix round, a feedback group, or the owner's /jig:bug · never on a session's own reading that something is broken
staged feedback, in the jig repo · one bug + spec per group; overlaps answered before any job opens
two or more gated jobs · one check on trunk; a failure is traced to its merge, then Fix on that job
the owner's word · refused while a batch check is owed; push and publish only on the owner's word
/jig:redocument · the spec is the remap; the last job is the cleanup
